about_the_game:
Build, Brew, and Belong.

Step into the shoes of a humble innkeeper in the late Middle Ages and build your own legacy from the ground up. Set between the 15th and 17th centuries, Tidehaven: Ale & Trade invites you to craft, expand, and customize your very own inn brick by brick, barrel by barrel.

What begins as a quiet tavern soon becomes the beating heart of a thriving settlement. As guests pour in, automate your services, optimize your staff, and unlock new rooms and facilities. But your journey doesn’t end at the inn’s doorstep, to shape the future of the town itself with new buildings, upgrades, and mini-games that breathe life into every cobblestone corner.

Featuring rich idle mechanics, medieval charm, and a touch of strategic depth, this is not just a game, it’s your own ever-growing world of trade, tales, and tankards.

Key Features:

  • Customize and expand your inn with kitchens, bedrooms, markets, secret meeting rooms for shady deals and more!

  • Hire and manage staff, serve guests, and keep the ale flowing.

  • Unlock tones of decoration items, unique items with perk systems for efficient management.

  • Upgrade and grow your village beyond the inn, build new structures and shape your town.

  • Discover special mini-games and events causing trouble or bring unforeseen fortune!

Whether you're a cozy decoration who loves "Olden days!" or a laid-back economy idle fan who enjoy medieval ambience, your story begins here.

short_description: From ale to empire, build, upgrade, and automate your way to medieval greatness! Customize your inn, grow your town, and unlock upgrades. Automate everything because even in the Middle Ages, micromanagement is for peasants.
